CRISTAUX : SAUTE · MÉTÉORES : RESTE AU S: CRYSTALS: JUMP · METEORS: STAY ON THE GROUND
Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Course sans fin sur une planète lointain: An endless run on a distant planet: jump over crystals (hold to jump higher, double jump in the air), stay on the ground under meteors, catch stars in a row for a multiplier up to ×4 and a shield to take a hit. The speed rises to more than double; score by distance and stars, record kept.
ESPACE : SAUTER · EN L'AIR : DOUBLE SAUT: SPACE: JUMP · IN THE AIR: DOUBLE JUMP
Espace, flèche du haut ou clic : sauter: Space, up arrow or click: jump (hold to jump higher, press again in the air for a double jump) · down: fall quickly · P or Esc: pause. Jump over the crystals, stay on the ground under the meteors, grab the stars in a row to multiply the points, and the shield to absorb a shock.
